Total consideration to target shareholders is the Merger Consideration, consisting of $30.00 in cash per share plus a number of Parent Common Stock shares equal to the Exchange Ratio (Stock Consideration).
Cash Consideration: $30.00 per share of Company Common Stock. Stock Consideration: a number of validly issued, fully paid and nonassessable shares of Parent Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio (the Stock Consideration), with the Exchange Ratio defined as 0.1574, per Company share; the Merger Consideration equals the Cash Consideration plus the Stock Consideration. Additional forms of consideration include equity award conversions (RSUs, PSUs, Deferred Director RSUs) into Parent stock or Merger Consideration via the Equity Award Conversion Ratio, and the cash-out of in-the-money Company and Prior Company Options, as well as cash in lieu for fractional shares; CVRs are not described.
0.1574; Each Company Common Stock share will be exchanged for $30.00 in cash plus 0.1574 shares of Parent Common Stock (the Stock Consideration), with no fractional shares issued (fractions settled in cash based on the last trading day closing price); the Equity Award Conversion Ratio is defined as the sum of the Exchange Ratio and the quotient obtained by dividing the Cash Consideration by the average closing price for a share of Parent Common Stock on the NYSE for the ten consecutive trading days ending on and including the last trading day immediately preceding the First Effective Time.
